name: eth_wallet_ui
description: View EVM assets and activity across enabled networks, and send on an explicitly selected chain. Holds no key material.
author: Logos Core Team

params.name: calls
params.description: The transactions to send, in order: [{ to, value?, data?, gasLimit?, label?, meta? }]

params.name: purpose
params.description: What the human is told the bundle is for, in the requester's words

params.name: chainId
params.description: Must be enabled and in the current device scope; absent uses the wallet's local Send-network selection

params.name: from
params.description: One of the wallet's accounts; absent means the selected one

params.name: tier
params.description: slow, normal or fast; absent means normal
